Before you post

The 60-second quality check

  • Hook in frame one. The bet, the balance or the question is visible before anything moves.
  • Payoff stays in. Never cut before the card lands or the ball drops — the ending is the clip.
  • Captions burned in. Most people watch muted. Big, readable text, kept clear of platform UI.
  • Tight trim. Cut dead air before and after the moment. If a second earns nothing, it goes.
  • Every link submitted. Post on four platforms? That’s four submissions in Clipster — unsubmitted posts don’t get counted.
  • Follow campaign rules. Check the Duel campaign brief in Clipster for required tags, disclosures and content rules before posting.

FAQ

Duel Clipping FAQ

How do I actually get paid?+
You join Clipster here, submit the link to each clip you post, and Clipster tracks the views on those submissions. Payouts are handled by Clipster under the Duel campaign’s terms — this page never touches your money.
How much do I earn per view?+
The rate is set per campaign inside the Clipster app and can change, so there is no honest fixed number to print here. Open the Duel campaign in Clipster to see the current rate before you clip, and use the estimator above with that rate.
Where do the clips come from?+
From duelclipping.com, the clipping player for Duel’s live games. It streams Duel Blackjack and Castle Roulette live and lets you rewind up to 48 hours to clip moments you missed live.
Do I need to gamble or deposit anything?+
No. Clipping is content work: you watch the public live stream, cut moments and post them. You never place a bet, never deposit, and never need a Duel balance to clip.
Which platforms can I post on?+
TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and X. Post natively on each platform, follow the campaign brief in Clipster for any required tags or disclosures, and submit every post link.
What kind of moments do best?+
Moments with a clear before-and-after: a huge double in Blackjack, a boosted Castle Roulette number landing, a dealer pulling an impossible 21. Tension plus a payoff inside 30 seconds is the formula — dead air is what kills a clip.
Is this an official Duel or Clipster page?+
No. DuelClipster (duelclipster.online) is an independent page. The links go to the real duelclipping.com player and to Clipster, but this site is not operated by Duel or Clipster.
Who can join?+
Adults only — 18+. The clips feature real-money casino gameplay, so you must meet the age and platform requirements in the Clipster campaign terms, and follow your local rules on gambling content.
How do I earn money clipping Duel?+
Watch live Duel Blackjack and Castle Roulette on duelclipping, clip a moment, post it on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or X, join Clipster through this page, submit your clip link, and earn per verified view.
What is Duel clipping?+
Cutting short clips from Duel’s live casino streams (Duel Blackjack and Castle Roulette) and posting them on social platforms to earn per verified view through Clipster campaigns.
How much can I earn clipping Duel?+
No fixed amount and no income is guaranteed. The rate is set per campaign inside the Clipster app and changes over time; earnings depend on verified views after you submit your clip.
What is the Duel clipping rate on Clipster?+
Rates change per campaign; check the current rate in the Clipster app. The campaign card shown on this page is a snapshot of a live campaign and its rate and budget change in the app.
How do I clip Duel Blackjack?+
Open the live player, rewind up to 48 hours to find a moment, clip it, add your own text/caption, then post it.
Do I need to deposit or gamble to earn from Duel clipping?+
No. You earn from views on your clips; you do not need to play or deposit.
Which platforms pay for Duel clips?+
It depends on the campaign; the live campaign shown on this page is Instagram only. Check each campaign’s platform in the Clipster app.
